notes: The dot at the head of the Update available pill now blinks. It is lit for three quarters of every two seconds and snaps on before fading off in sixty milliseconds -- the only thing on the face of the radio that moves of its own accord, which is what lets a notice that small and that quiet still be caught out of the corner of the eye. A machine set to reduced motion gets the dot held lit instead, because the blink is only the part that asks for a glance. Nothing else about the notice changed: the same pill in the same place in every theme, the cross beside it still a snooze until the next completed check, and the mark on the Settings control still untouched by it.
